description: This file defines the Conditional interface for handling <if> conditional elements within the MiniLang framework of Apache OFBiz, including method signatures for condition checking and pretty printing.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: Interface for all conditional elements under the <if> element, defining methods to evaluate conditions and perform pretty printing.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates the condition in the given MethodContext, returning true or false, and potentially throws a MiniLangException if an error occurs.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Provides a pretty-printed representation of the conditional element using the provided StringBuilder and MethodContext.
